question: The mission of the spliceosome is:

options.opa: Ensure that the transfer RNAs adopt the trefoil configuration.
options.opb: Prevent ribosomes from entering the nucleus.
options.ope: Facilitate the maturation of the mRNA precursor, since it approximates the splice points.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Facilitate the maturation of the mRNA precursor -> Approximate the splice points -> Remove introns -> 80% CHAIN: Facilitate the maturation of the mRNA precursor -> Form mature mRNA -> Export mature mRNA from the nucleus -> 85% CHAIN: Facilitate the maturation of the mRNA precursor -> Remove introns -> Join exons -> Form mature mRNA -> 80%
